upstream.method: Unauthenticated HTTPS source archive. No fork, git clone, or GitHub account.

patch.format: Unified text diff with git file headers; complete changed source and vendored additions included

exclusions.reason: Generated build output, dependency caches, and OS housekeeping are not authored source changes.

git_metadata_scan.scope: source tree including vendor, excluding directories/prefixes above
git_metadata_scan.result: No .git directories or .git indirection files found.

verification.patch_dry_run: passed using /usr/bin/patch -p1 against changed originals read from upstream archive
verification.patch_actual_application: passed in temporary scratch directory; all resulting changed file bytes match current source exactly
